_doc: LLM providers, prices and evaluation presets for cqa/llm.py and cqa/evaluator.py. Model ids are 'provider:model' (split on the first colon only, so 'ollama:qwen2.5:7b-instruct' works). Env overrides: CQA_PROFILE (cloud|claude|local|mock), CQA_MODEL (main model for both modes), CQA_ARBITER_MODEL, CQA_BASE_URL/CQA_API_KEY (OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. DeepSeek), CQA_OLLAMA_URL, CQA_USD_KZT.

fallback._doc: cqa/llm.py: on 402/no credits switch to this model at once; on 429/5xx/connection errors back off exponentially up to backoff_total_s, then switch; on timeouts after `retries`. Not used for mock or when the failed model has the same provider. A profile may override with its own "fallback" (null = off). Env: CQA_FALLBACK_MODEL (none = off), CQA_BACKOFF_TOTAL_S. Answers carry usage.fallback=true and the real provider/model.

pricing_usd_per_mtok._doc: USD per 1M tokens. DeepSeek: list prices (cache miss / cache hit / output), check https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing. claude_cli reports total_cost_usd itself; these rows are used only by the anthropic SDK provider. ollama = 0.
pricing_usd_per_mtok._doc_openrouter: OpenRouter model ids (CQA_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1), list prices from GET /api/v1/models on 2026-11-07. Longest matching prefix wins only if exact id is absent; keep exact ids here.

cloud._doc: Main cloud mode on an OpenAI-compatible API (OpenRouter). Fast = one call per dialogue; chosen 2026-11-07 by a 6-model bake-off on the 21 holdout dialogues with guidance m1-g9: google/gemini-4-argon 95.6% vs silver (95.3% gold_v2), ~$0.046 and ~41 s per dialogue; next: claude-sonnet-5.5 92.5-95.0%, qwen3.8-27b 93.1%, deepseek-v4-pro 92.5%. Control runs use fast. Accurate = one Gemini call per criterion, 1 vote, no arbiter (not benchmarked; about 8x the tokens of fast).

accurate._doc: One Gemini call per criterion (focused prompt), 1 vote, no arbiter. Not benchmarked; about 8x the tokens of fast. Majority votes of 3-5 models in fast mode were simulated on the 21 holdout dialogues (2026-11-07) and did not beat Gemini alone beyond noise (best 153/159 vs 152/159 at ~2x cost), so no multi-model vote here.

claude._doc: Team subscription through the claude CLI. Use for spot checks only; temperature is not controllable in the CLI (votes differ by sampling). CLI aliases are supported by --help; resolved_models records actual model IDs on successful calls. CLI total_cost_usd is a usage estimate, not an additional subscription invoice.

cascade._doc: Cheap model first, stronger model only when needed (cqa/evaluator.py _cascade). Haiku 5.5 evaluates the dialogue; if any criterion needs review (low confidence, failed validation, critical flag, keyword-rule disagreement), Gemini 4 Argon re-evaluates the whole dialogue and its answers are used. Measured live on the 21 holdout dialogues with guidance m1-g9 (2026-11-07, run or-hold-cascade-g9): 95.6% vs silver and 95.3% vs gold_v2, the same as Gemini alone; 9 of 21 dialogues escalated; $0.025 per dialogue instead of $0.046 (1.8x cheaper; the Gemini stage priced by tokens x config prices, including cache replays). For volume; the control run uses profile cloud.

routing._doc: Bank policy routing (cqa/evaluator.py _route + _cascade): phone calls go straight to Gemini 4 Argon (long, ASR-noisy; skips the cheap first pass and roughly halves their latency); chats start on Haiku 5.5 and are escalated to Gemini when Haiku marks any criterion for review OR answers C3 Identification with yes/no, i.e. the operator touched the client's account data. Run through the product on the cache, 21 holdout dialogues: 152/159, 10 of 21 dialogues on Gemini, $0.0261 per dialogue (Gemini stages priced by tokens x config prices); 'account data only' without the doubt trigger gave 153 or 149 depending on the Haiku run.

local._doc: Local model through Ollama native /api/chat (num_ctx 16k, think off), base URL from CQA_OLLAMA_URL (default localhost). Measured: qwen2.5:7b-instruct Q4_K_M on a MacBook Air M4 16 GB, fully offline, DEV holdout 21 dialogues: 99/159 = 62.3% vs the machine reference (Gemini 95.6%), mean 341 s per dialogue - a draft/triage quality, not a replacement for the cloud model. Planned upgrade on an 8 GB RTX GPU: qwen3.5:9b Q4_K_M (not measured). No cloud fallback for ollama models (cqa/llm.py fallback_model): if the local server is down the evaluation fails loudly instead of sending dialogues out.
